integrity: The two autonomous models, analytic proof, reproducible source code, exact source identifiers, source access limitations, and lack of independent validation are disclosed. No empirical generalization is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact cross-model equality holds only for initial states on a codimension-one curved invariant surface and the specified parameter matching. Off-manifold states are distinguishable, and the periodic base cycles are neutrally stable. The included symbolic and numerical verification checks do not constitute independent review. The motivating study supplement was not independently inspected, and broad earlier observability theory may contain more general implications.
title: Exact camouflage of a hard triadic ecological interaction on an attracting product manifold
